rapport_notes: Amy is warm, patient, clear, and reassuring throughout; handles technical hiccups gracefully and makes the customer feel heard.
process_discipline_notes: After the estimate explanation ('do you have any questions so far'), Amy does not hold silence; the customer immediately asks to book, so no pause to absorb is captured.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Okay, I'll start with the first and last name, please... I'll just ask you some more questions to create the profile and you know get started on the right track. This call will probably take five to ten minutes and you don't have to take notes I'll send everything via email once we get off the phone.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Okay, I think I got all the details that I need unless you want to share anything else like a specific concern or what are you most worried about for the upcoming move Alexandra?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'The only thing there, we do have a tank it's about, I wanna say maybe a forty to fifty gallon all glass tank that will need to be moved as well. That's probably the only, the most fragile thing that we have.' Amy: 'Yeah, yes we can definitely move that but you'll empty it out right before the move day.' [No follow-up on whether there are other fragile items, no 'what else' probe.]
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: What's included in our service would of course the wrapping, the protection, but just for the furniture but also the gallon tank...
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: A typical two bedroom apartment move. Usually it would just take four and a half to five and a half hours to complete your inventory is pretty, pretty straightforward. But I want to highlight that we're moving out of a third floor apartment no elevator. So, I want to be a bit consider suggest budgeting for five and a half hours. Let's say up to six and a half hours...
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: If you guys are able to take a car load of boxes or you know, disassemble the bed in advance anything that you can, to reduce the time would really help you save a lot of money...
evidence_quotes.close: We don't require a deposit. So let's go ahead and lock the date... Okay. So we'll see you on Friday December 4th 8:30 to nine ETA the movers will give you a call once they're on the way to boss creek apartments and I'll send you the confirmation email once we get off the phone.

top_strength: Amy delivered a clear, personalized estimate anchored to a typical 2-bed range and adjusted upward for the third-floor no-elevator scenario, giving the customer concrete budgeting confidence.
coaching_note: Two critical Stage 1 gaps: ask 'their agenda' *before* logistics probing (not after), and when a customer surfaces a concern (the fragile aquarium), probe two layers deep—ask 'what else' or 'tell me more'—to uncover all concerns before moving to pricing; also, Stage 2 is almost entirely missing (no On-Time Guarantee, no Communication differentiators, no real 'takeaway' close), and the close lacks both a rate-lock statement and an explicit ask for the business.
